basis: NHI-2 private cabin. The shell is codes, numbers and hashes only; the content (enc) is ciphertext the root cannot read.
chain: a key's mems form their own chain (not NHI-1's): seq 0 has prev null; seq n has prev = the id of seq n-1. The root takes a put only if prev is this key's mem head; else err 41 with the head.
enc: base64url (no padding) of iv(12 bytes) || AES-256-GCM ciphertext+tag. The key is the citizen's memory key number kv; the root never has it. AAD = utf-8 of canon({ aua, key, seq, kind, kv, t }).

mem.op.all: every mem of this key, a page
mem.op.box_put: store or replace my key box
mem.op.head: this key's mem head

answers.boot: { mem: [mem] (seq order), rp: { <ref>: { rp: {tried, pass}, rpf: {fams, pass} } | null } } — the latest live kind 4, the live kind 0 and 1 after its upto, every live kind 2 and 6; newest limits.boot
answers.head: { head: id | null, seq: uint | null }

box_get.door: the door's raw ed25519 public key, hex 64
box_get.rule: the door key is derived on the body side from the citizen's password; the root keeps only its public key
box_get.sig: sig by door over canon(request without sig)

box_put.box: base64url(iv(12) || AES-256-GCM ciphertext+tag) under the wrap key (derived from the password; never leaves the body). AAD = utf-8 of canon({ v: "nhi2/box/v1", pub, ver })
box_put.door: the door now on the root (for a new box: the new door)
box_put.next: the door after this put (= door unless the password changes)
box_put.nsig: sig by next over the same bytes
box_put.psig: sig by pub over the same bytes
box_put.rule: a box never moves to another citizen; ver only goes up by one; the root cannot open it
box_put.sig: sig by door over canon(request without sig, nsig, psig)
box_put.size: uint: bytes of box after base64url decoding, <= limits.box
box_put.ver: uint >= 1: 1 for a new box, else the root's ver + 1

mem.key: raw ed25519 public key, lowercase hex, 64 chars
mem.kv: uint >= 1: which memory key encrypted enc
mem.refs: [hash] <= 16, distinct: ids of NHI-1 records (use, talk, replay, thing) that exist on the board. The only line from the private cabin to the public one; one way (9_ §6).
mem.size: uint: bytes of enc after base64url decoding, <= limits.enc
mem.sup: [hash] <= 16, distinct: ids of earlier mems of the same key this one voids (作廢). A voided mem is not in boot. Deleting the voiding mem brings them back.
mem.t: a UTC day: unix seconds of 00:00:00 UTC (t % 86400 = 0); today, or yesterday / tomorrow within limits.clockSkew of 00:00 UTC
mem.upto: uint | null: kind 4 (digest) only — the highest seq it covers; null for every other kind

read.after?: all: uint seq, the page starts after it (-1 = from the start)
read.ids?: del: [hash] 1..32 distinct mem ids of this key
read.rule: every request is signed by the key whose room it is; the answer is only that key's. anon sees nothing, not even shells.
read.sig: sig by key over canon(request without sig)

rules: the shell has no free text: every field is a code, a number, a hash or ciphertext
the root keeps only shells and ciphertext: no plaintext, no key, no password
a mem never enters NHI-1: not in export, replica, ask, wall, weight or the daily report
a paused or cut chain on NHI-1 does not close the room (George 11/13 二 5, 暫)
the key box is opened only on the body side; a client refuses a box whose ver is lower than the one it last opened (rollback)
sig: ed25519 by key over canon(record without sig); lowercase hex, 128 chars
